title: Dynamic Contrast Enhanced Magnetic Resonance Imaging Protocol
author: John Rutledge
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yh9ft96

Let the macro run its course.

steps.title: Prepare Animal
steps.instruction: Ensure the animal has undergone the Femoral Vein Cannulation protocol prior to DCE-MRI.

steps.title: Install Microgradients and Animal Stage
steps.instruction: Set up the hardware components within the 7T NMR facility.

substeps.instruction: Transport mice to the NMR facility.
Turn off the main power source to the 7T and the water circulator.
Disconnect power cables and water circulator from the standard gradient to the 7T.
Insert the microgradient (approx. 40 lbs) into the 7T bore.
Connect power cables and water circulator from the microgradient to the 7T.
Verify the microgradient isocenter position using the ruler measurement posted at the front of the bore.
Turn main power and water circulator back on.
Fill distilled water past the indicated mark in the circulating water heater.
Connect the water heater tubing, thread it through the animal stage, and tape it in place.
Place the animal stage on the 7T stage and tape it into place.
Turn on the water heater to warm up.

steps.title: Position Animal in 7T
steps.instruction: Secure the animal and position it within the microgradient.

substeps.instruction: Place the animal in the supine position at the tip of the animal stage.
Insert the bite bar into the mouth; ensure the head is straight and taut from the body, then tape the bite bar and head in place.
Place the circulating water heater on the animal's abdomen.
Insert the animal into the microgradient, ensuring the stage does not touch the microgradient and no limbs or tail are hanging out.
Verify the cannula tubing is long enough to remain accessible outside the bore.
Ensure the head of the animal is at the isocenter of the microgradient.

steps.title: Configure Computer and Imaging Parameters
steps.instruction: Initialize the software and load the specific imaging protocol.

substeps.instruction: Open Paravision 5 program.
Navigate to File > New and enter subject set-up information.
Open the 'Tools' window via the wrench icon.
Load the protocol from the 'Anderson' file folder.
Verify imaging parameters (e.g., voxel size 32mm x 32mm x 1mm) and make adjustments prior to running.

steps.title: Perform Initial Calibration Scans
steps.instruction: Run preliminary protocols to verify animal positioning.

substeps.instruction: Run Protocol 1 (One Pulse).
Run Protocol 2 (RARE_VTR Tripilot).
Use the measurement tool to ensure the brain sulcus is 5mm from the isocenter; adjust animal position if necessary.
Repeat Protocol 1 until the animal is in the proper place.
Run Protocol 3 (MSME).
Run Protocol 4 (Perfpack060314).
Run Protocol 5 (RARE_VTR_micro).

steps.title: Set Up and Run Macro
steps.instruction: Configure the automated scan sequence for baseline measurement.

substeps.instruction: Open the 'macro' screen by clicking the black hat.
Locate the Scan N protocol (where N=10).
Clone Protocol 5 ten times.
Place the mouse cursor at the first scan (scan 6) and run the Macro.
Allow the baseline measurement to begin automatically.

steps.title: Administer Contrast Agent
steps.instruction: Inject Magnevist and saline flush during the macro sequence.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a syringe with Magnevist (diluted or undiluted in saline based on animal weight) for injection at 0.5ml/kg, hooked to the cannula.
When the baseline measurement reaches 80%, count 8 'clicks' and start the infusion.
Immediately follow the infusion with a saline flush of the same volume.
Allow the macro to run its course.

steps.title: Final Imaging and Data Storage
steps.instruction: Complete the final scans and secure the data.

substeps.instruction: Run Protocol 17 (MSME).
Run Protocol 18 (Perfpack060314).
Save data to the hard drive.
Upload data to the Kona server for safe storage.
